revisions.prompt: Redraw this exact monster as a TRUE 90-degree orthographic LEFT SIDE PROFILE turnaround. Camera is exactly perpendicular to the creature's side. One visible eye (if eyes), overlapping far limbs, nose/muzzle pointing horizontally LEFT, chest in profile. Lower weapons into resting position. For winged creatures only one side wing silhouette, wings partially folded. For the mechanical furnace arm show a horizontal arm in exact side elevation, wall edge-on at RIGHT. For the flying book show narrow thickness/spine in side profile with one folded wing, do NOT show the broad front cover. Keep same identity, anatomy, costume details and colors. Single full body with all appendages visible, plain white background, crisp cel-shaded game concept, no text, no duplicate or sheet. For humanoids draw the face entirely in profile with ONE eye visible and NO front view of face/chest.
